name: 草绳捆扎清蒸整蟹款
description: 墨黑宴席底+中国红方块信息图，捆扎整蟹蘸醋的熟制水产详情页视觉

styleLock.direction: dark banquet Chinese crab cuisine ecommerce with red-block infographic system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: ink black #111111 for dark gourmet bands and hero screens, warm paper white #FDFBF7 for infographic screens, deep navy woven cloth #22304E as the recurring food surface
styleLock.lightingSystem: single warm 3500K directional key from the upper left with deep natural falloff, deep controlled shadows, moist sheen and controlled highlights on the shell, soft contact shadow, no flat shadowless fill and no harsh plastic speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte black slate #1A1A1A, deep navy woven cloth #22304E, natural bamboo steamer weave #C89B5E, white porcelain plate #F7F5F0, small dark dipping dish #141414
styleLock.typography: modern bold geometric sans-serif headline type, charcoal text #2B2B2B on light screens and #FDFBF7 on dark screens, no brush calligraphy, no custom lettering, no English micro-lines
styleLock.iconSystem: circular red badge labels #C8161D with white short labels and simple thin-line icons in the single red accent
styleLock.presentationRules: product always shown whole and rope-tied, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable scale, garnish and condiments kept at the edges and never covering the product
noDrift: no rope color or tying change
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark banquet Chinese crab cuisine e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ink black background #111111, warm paper white #FDFBF7, deep navy woven cloth #22304E and one Chinese red accent #C8161D with charcoal text #2B2B2B; warm tone throughout; single warm 3500K directional key light from the upper left with deep natural falloff, deep controlled shadows, moist sheen and controlled highlights on the shell and soft contact shadows, never flat shadowless fill and never plastic-looking; modern bold geometric sans-serif headline type, no brush calligraphy and no custom lettering; consistent circular red badge labels and simple thin-line icons in the single red accent; surfaces limited to matte black slate #1A1A1A, deep navy woven cloth #22304E, natural bamboo steamer weave #C89B5E, white porcelain #F7F5F0 and small dark dipping dish #141414; product always presented whole and rope-tied at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle and stable scale with garnish and condiments kept at the edges; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random bright backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting direction, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking food texture, no rope color or tying change.

shots.props: one small dark dipping dish, a pair of wooden chopsticks and one sprig of fresh green herb, none covering the product

Whole rope-tied crabs plated on a matte black slate plate, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down across the table, the full platter visible and never clipped by the frame, the platter filling 60-70% of the frame with the dish, chopsticks and herb arranged around its edges so the frame reads as one complete banquet composition. Deep navy woven cloth #22304E over an ink black table #111111. Props: one small dark dipping dish, a pair of wooden chopsticks and one sprig of fresh green herb, none of them covering the product. shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right, in #FDFBF7

Right panel: {product} shown whole, rope-tied and moist under the same warm 3500K directional key from the upper left on deep navy woven cloth #22304E, filling 40-50% of its panel and carrying one short label 「{callout_2}」. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. provenance.notes: 源图仅 6 屏（800x1200 详情页长图切片）逐屏分析提炼；已剥离原湖区产地名、店铺会员二维码、原图文案与独特毛笔标题排版，产品一律以 {product} 占位，规格/产地/资质数值全部改为 {callout_n} 文案槽位由使用方填写，资质凭据不进图、只保留可验证的工序画面。源图仅 6 屏且无独立痛点屏，第 3 镜痛点对屏按生鲜水产详情页行业惯例补足。
